title: Федя и жена инспектора  (Fedya and the Inspector's Wife)

segments.t: When Chef Barinov told Fedya that the inspector's wife was on him, Fedya took it as an order to seduce her. Enraged by the revelation, the inspector tries to attack before Senya knocks him out again with a vase.
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.

'Fedya, what are you doing over there?' Here wondering what Fedya doing over there is shows Barinov looking for the real truth. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
'You said the wife was on me.' Saying that Barinov said the wife was on him is how Fedya sets the tone with Barinov.
'And now I have understood everything.' Having understood everything is how the inspector lays out the situation for Barinov.

'You are simply mocking me.' Mentioning that Barinov is simply mocking him moves the talk in a new direction. Russian packs the whole idea of what is allowed or needed into one impersonal word at the front.
'Your cook seduced my wife.' Around the truth and work, the inspector sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov.

'You nearly killed me.' Around the truth and point, the inspector sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov. Even in the middle of the drama, he keeps the polite plural "you" that workplace Russian expects.
'There is actually no money at all.' Explaining that there is actually no money at all lays the cards on the table for Barinov.
'Enough, let us sort this out calmly.' Barinov mentions that enough let them sort this out calmly so Fedya sees what is at stake.
'Soon they will bring us this money.' Claiming that soon they will bring them this money sounds confident, even if Fedya has doubts.
'And we will part ways peacefully.' Pointing out that they will part ways peacefully gives Fedya a sobering reality check.
'Fedya, you be quiet altogether right now.' Barinov explains that Fedya is quiet altogether right now, keeping his voice calm and direct.

'Well, you see, we reached an agreement.' With the inspector and point in play, Barinov keeps this short reply brisk and direct. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
With the inspector tied up in a hotel room, Mikhail Jekovich hears strange noises through the door and comes to investigate. Until next time!
